    have h₆ : x < 45 / 8 := by
      have h₇ : 0 < (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 := by

      have h₈ : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x := h₁
      have h₉ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x)
      have h₁₀ : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 + 2 * x := by
        apply Real.sq_sqrt
        linarith
      field_simp at h₃
      rw [← sub_pos] at h₃
      have h₁₁ : 4 * x ^ 2 < (2 * x + 9) * (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 := by
        linarith

        sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1)]

  · rintro ⟨h₅, h₆, h₄⟩
    have h₁ : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x := by linarith

        have h₁₀ : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 := by rw [h₈]
        have h₁₁ : 1 + 2 * x = 1 := by
          have h₁₂ : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x := h₁
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt h₁₂]
        exact h₁₁
      have h₁₀ : x = 0 := by linarith
      exact h₄ h₁₀
    have h₃ : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := by
      have h₇ : 0 < (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 := by
        apply pow_pos
        intro h
        exact h₂ h
      have h₈ : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * x := h₁
      have h₉ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + 2 * x)
      have h₁₀ : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = 1 + 2 * x := by
        apply Real.sq_sqrt
        linarith
      have h₁₁ : 4 * x ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 * (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 := by
        have h₁₂ : 2 * x = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 - 1 := by
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt h₈]
        calc
          4 * x ^ 2 = (2 * x) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = ((Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 := by rw [h₁₂]
          _ = ((Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) - 1) * (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1)) ^ 2 := by
            rw [← sub_eq_zero]
            ring_nf
            <;> nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt h₈]
          _ = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) - 1) ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 := by
            congr 1
            ring_nf
          _ = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 * (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 := by ring
      have h₁₂ : 4 * x ^ 2 / (1 - Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x)) ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 := by
        rw [h₁₁]
        field_simp [h₂]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₁₂]
      have h₁₃ : (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) + 1) ^ 2 < 2 * x + 9 := by
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt h₈, sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * x) - 7 / 2)]
      linarith
    exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
